description: At a time when our democracy is threatened from within as never before, we need courageous, bold, and experienced people to defend our country, our freedoms, and the balance of power. Ed is that a person. He has been fighting for Massachusetts and the United States his entire adult life and Senator Markey has proven to be very effective. -Jim Segel
